1.explanation: The code uses Puppeteer to launch a browser and navigate to a URL. It then minimizes the tab to simulate it being in the background. Lighthouse is run on the URL, and the NO_FCP error is expected to occur due to the tab being in the background, preventing performance metrics from being captured.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves running Lighthouse (LH) on a URL, such as https://www.google.com/, while the tab is in the background. This results in a NO_FCP (No First Contentful Paint) error, preventing performance measurement. The issue occurs regardless of whether the server is remote or local, and persists even with a clean Chrome profile. The CLI version of LH works fine, but the extension fails to evaluate performance and check the PWA checklist.
